summary: Oncotelic Therapeutics filed an 8-K on July 13, 2026, solely to furnish a corporate presentation to employees, directors, and advisors. The filing contains no announcement of a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or any other special-situation transaction. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or recommendations are provided. The presentation is furnished under Item 8.01 and is not deemed filed for Exchange Act purposes. This is a routine disclosure with no actionable event for special-situations analysis.
